paragraphs.text: Narwhal is an obsolete creature type which represented a race of horned whales that often inhabit snow regions.
Narwhal debuted as a creature type in Homelands on Narwhal . The type was made obsolete and given errata to just be whale during the Grand Creature Type Update .
Narwhals are known to live in the seas of Ulgrotha . Kakra was a sea troll who claimed to rip off their horns and use them to stab fish .
